description_en: Queries the information about an agent in the Cloud Customer Service System by agent account name
description_zh: 根据坐席账号名称查询悉犀客服工作台坐席信息
name: GetAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The account name of the agent. This value is unique within the instance and is used as the logon name
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name
